Our climate models have a big, dangerous blind spot
stories.summary: A powerful feedback loop could drive more warming than predicted. Climate change itself is increasingly fueling climate change. Rising concentrations of greenhouse gases are driving up global temperatures, setting off dangerous feedback loops that we have not fully accounted for in our climate models—or our emissions-reduction goals. Scientists have long warned that warming would propel further warming in various ways, but a growing number of observations and studies are at last providing a sharper sense of just how powerful these cascading effects could be. And, by extension, they’re showing how much faster the planet may warm in this century.

A friend was calling to tell him a rumor he heard at a barbershop. The friend said he heard Stewart had been arrested at a park in Pittsburgh "because of lewd acts being performed on me by a transvestite," as Stewart describes it. "None of this stuff ever happened," Stewart said on Oct. 28, 28 years later.
